Flavor DS Brand

The Brand DS is the fixed identity layer: it does not re-theme. Product surfaces theme through Core UI; the brand stays stable so the company is recognizable in every theme.

Brand 2 — the alternate pair

Same system, second identity: data-hue="brand2". Primary Magenta carries the accents, Cyan is the secondary (buttons with data-tone="secondary", focus ring, accent border). Both are full 12-step ramps in Core UI, in muted / regular / bold.
